findings.detail: When an upstream lookup fails without producing JSON, the pipeline's `|| true` makes the assignment succeed, and the empty-latest branch returns successfully without recording an unavailable result. If no other surface produces a drift row, the script exits successfully with empty stdout. The companion workflow interprets that as no drift and closes an existing drift issue, even though its stale pin was never checked. Removing stderr redirection exposes the diagnostic but does not prevent this incorrect action. This defect predates the change.
findings.evidence: At lines 206-211, a failed Node lookup becomes an empty latest value followed by a successful return. print_report at lines 742-744 emits nothing when drift_rows is empty. The companion version-audit-workflow-template.yml sets has_drift=false for empty stdout and its Close stale audit issue step closes the open issue. The other runtime and registry lookup helpers use the same failure-to-empty pattern.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: upstream failures still become a no-drift success

findings.detail: A Copilot reply at position 21 through 100 in an unresolved Copilot-opened thread falls between the two retrieval paths. fetch returns only the first 20 comments, while audit indexes the first 100 and suppresses comments belonging to Copilot-opened threads as already covered. A concern appearing only in reply 21 is therefore neither returned for processing nor listed as uncovered. The fetch result contains no nested pageInfo or totalCount to signal that the caller needs the documented manual longer-thread fallback. This defect predates the change.
findings.evidence: do_fetch requests comments(first: 20) at line 241 and returns only those nodes. fetch_thread_index requests comments(first: 100) at line 646. do_parse_audit indexes every fetched comment at lines 555-564, then drops a known comment from a Copilot-opened thread at lines 575-584, regardless of whether do_fetch actually returned that comment.
findings.title: Parallel paths: the audit hides replies beyond the fetcher's comment cap
